title: Search for exosomal biomarkers for urological tumors
summary:
We search markers for the early diagnosis of urological Tumors (see also mammography Screening or PSA-Screening).

We use Patient samples (Urine, blood, tissue) and isolate specific content (Proteins, DNA, other nucleic acids) and examine their use as tumor marker. The aim is to establish easy, low risk test for the safe discrimination of individuals with or without Tumor.
conditions: Malignant neoplasm of kidney, except renal pelvis

interventions.name: Healthy individuals (sample collection, evaluation of tumor markers in urine, blood, tissue)
Patients with prostate cancer (sample collection, evaluation of tumor markers in urine, blood, tissue)
Patients with renal cell carcinoma (sample collection, evaluation of tumor markers in urine, blood, tissue)
Patients with bladder cancer (sample collection, evaluation of tumor markers in urine, blood, tissue)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patient with urological tumor or individual without tumor as control group
Exclusion criteria:
refusal of participation
